summary: Approximately 181,035 km² and about 17.4 million people (2023), from Wikidata's Q424 (P2046, P1082). The English Wikipedia article "Cambodia", at revision 1375873949, opens: "Cambodia, officially the Kingdom of Cambodia, is a country in Mainland Southeast Asia. It is bordered by Thailand to the northwest, Laos to the north, and Vietnam to the east, and has a coastline along the Gulf of Thailand in the southwest. It spans an area of about 181,035 km2 (69,898 sq mi), dominated by a low-lying plain and the confluence of the Mekong river and Tonlé Sap, Southeast Asia's largest lake." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Entity 811 in the Gleditsch–Ward state list, as mapped by CShapes 2.0, a dataset of the borders and capitals of states and dependencies between 1886 and 2019. The dataset gives it 1 period of territorial validity, from 1953 to where the dataset stops, in 2019. Its last capital in the dataset is Phnom Penh. The code is mapped onto more than one actor (data/imports/cshapes-actors.json); this record holds the periods from 1953-11-09. This record was written by the import from those fields and asserts nothing the dataset does not.
